# Vendored files

These files are copied in unchanged from their published packages, so a figure draws the same way years from now and needs no network. The version is in each file name. Do not edit them. To upgrade, add the new file beside the old one and change the names in `gem-figure.js` and in each figure's `index.html`.

| File | Package and version | Source | License |
|------|---------------------|--------|---------|
| `d3-7.9.0.min.js` | d3 7.9.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js | ISC |
| `topojson-client-3.1.0.min.js` | topojson-client 3.1.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js | ISC |
| `world-atlas-2.0.2-countries-50m.json` | world-atlas 2.0.2 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2.0.2/countries-50m.json | ISC. The boundaries are from Natural Earth, which is public domain. |
| `us-atlas-3.0.1-states-10m.json` | us-atlas 3.0.1 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/us-atlas@3.0.1/states-10m.json | ISC. The boundaries are from the US Census Bureau, which is public domain. |

The fonts in `../gem-fonts.css` are Plus Jakarta Sans and Barlow Semi Condensed, both under the SIL Open Font License.

The country boundaries are Natural Earth's. They are a drawing aid and do not state a GEM position on any border.
